description: Monthly gross base pay (Grundgehalt) in euro for a rank or a pay grade (A 3 to A 16, B 1 to B 10), per experience level (Erfahrungsstufe 1-8; B grades have none). year 2026 = payments since 1 May 2026, 2025 = 1 April 2025 to 30 April 2026. Both are advance payments (Abschlag) not yet enacted by law. Without family allowance, bonuses and deductions.

pay_grade.description: Instead of rank: a pay grade such as "A 9" or "B 6"

rank.description: A Bundeswehr rank name or abbreviation in German, any service, e.g. "Hauptmann", "KKpt", "Oberstabsarzt", "Flieger".

name: base_pay
title: Bundeswehr base pay (Besoldung)
